'''Resk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed on Resk around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] tracked Resk to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. During their confrontation, Resk threatened to expose Hett as a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to the proper authorities if brought before them. Resk's threat prompted Hett to [[Sai cha/Legends|behead]] his target with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], further sinking the former Jedi into the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You don't dare take me in, Hett! You do and I'll tell the ''authorities'' you're a Jedi! Then the bounty's on ''you''&mdash;|Resk's final words to A'Sharad Hett, interrupted by decapitation|<ref name="Legacy 17" />}}
Resk was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived<ref name="Legacy 17" /> during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> after a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed on Resk, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] eventually tracked Resk to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where they were both forced to the world's surface due to a storm. Resk fled from Hett and attempted self-defense with a pair of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] but was disarmed by the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. As Hett cornered Resk, the latter threatened to inform the authorities of the former's status as an ex-Jedi, which prompted Hett to silence Resk via [[Sai tok/Legends|beheading]], as the bounty on Resk's head was the same whether the target was living or [[Death/Legends|deceased]]. After Resk's death, Hett, who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], discovered the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[XoXaan]]'s [[XoXaan's holocron|holocron]], which taught the former Jedi Master the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] over the next few years.<ref name="Legacy 17" />

Resk was light-skinned with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a beard, and long hair. During the fatal confrontation with Hett, Resk wore jewelry and wielded two [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].<ref name="Legacy 17" />

==Behind the scenes==
Resk was created by [[John Ostrander]], the writer of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comics]], for the [[Legacy (2006) 17|fourth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Legacy: Claws of the Dragon|''Claws of the Dragon'']] story arc. He was drawn by [[Jan Duursema]].
